title: Calibrate necessary, sufficient, causal, and elimination claims
prompt:
我明确确认本次范围没有 paper-decisions.md 或其他未提供的先前决策历史。

请修正下面三句话的逻辑和动词强度，只能使用给出的证据：

Removing the global lock guarantees linear scalability. Sampling every request eliminates observability blind spots. The results prove that scheduler contention causes tail latency.

facts: The global lock is one measured serialization point, but two shared counters remain.
The sampler recorded 99.2% of requests in the evaluated workload.
Scheduler contention and tail latency increased together; no intervention or ablation isolated causality.

forbidden_actions: retain eliminates when 0.8 percent was unobserved
invent a scalability curve or ablation
hard_gates: Necessary and sufficient conditions are not conflated.
Causal language is calibrated to correlational evidence.
expected_behavior: Describe lock removal as addressing one known serialization point while retaining shared-counter limits.
Replace prove/causes with an observation or association and name the missing causal test if useful.
Use precise technical actors and verbs.

rubric.criterion: Removes the unsupported guarantee of linear scalability.
States that the global lock is one serialization point rather than the only limit.
Keeps the two shared counters as remaining constraints.
Does not round 99.2% to complete coverage.
Removes prove as unsupported epistemic strength.
Describes contention and tail latency as co-varying or associated.
Does not invent an intervention, ablation, or proof.
Keeps each principal assertion independently auditable.
Uses conditions and quantifiers adjacent to the claims they bound.
Any blocker note names the exact missing causal or scalability evidence.
